messages.author: 9e72ef8d095655b8
messages.subject: Interpretation of L5TIME_num_pla and L5VALUE_pla
parts:
Hello everyone,

could someone please tell me, how to interpret the columns "L10TIME_num_pla" and M10TIME_num_pla"? In the vignette it only says "Timing of least/most active 10hrs" but which unit is the output in?  

Thank you in advance for your help and best regards

Fabian

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Interpretation of L5TIME_num_pla and L5VALUE_pla
parts:
Hi Fabian

Sorry, this is indeed not clear in the documentation.

The time is expressed as hours relative to preceding midnight to make it consistent with how numeric times are expressed for sleep onset and waking up time.  So. 26 corresponds to 1.00 AM, and 37 corresponds to 1pm.

For WW defined windows (waking-up to waking-up) this is useful because days do not start at a set hour.

Note that in the day summary you will have both the numeric time and the clock time.

I hope this clarifies it. I will have  look at how i can improve the documentation.

Best,
Vincent
